name: daypass
description: Search hotel day passes, beach clubs and spa days on Daypass.com with live availability and prices.

interface.longDescription: Daypass.com lets you enjoy a hotel for the day without staying overnight. Ask for what you want, for example "somewhere with a pool in Cancún this Saturday for two", and get hotels, resorts, beach clubs and spas with real availability for that date: price per person, total for your group, guest ratings and a Book button. Filter by amenities, vibe, budget per person or for the group, and currency; with children, only passes that admit them are shown. More than 500 hotels in Mexico, the Caribbean, Colombia, Spain and Southeast Asia. Searching is read-only and needs no account; booking and payment are completed on daypass.com.
defaultPrompt: Use Daypass.com to find a day pass with a pool in Cancún this Saturday for two.
Use Daypass.com to find an all-inclusive day pass in Punta Cana, prices in USD.

positive.description: Pool day pass for a couple in Cancún
positive.prompt: Find a day pass with a pool in Cancún this Saturday for 2 adults, prices in Mexican pesos
positive.expected_behavior: Calls buscar_daypasses with location Cancún, the date of the coming Saturday, 2 adults and the outdoor pool amenity. Shows a card carousel (MCP App) of Cancún hotels with live availability for that date: photo, rating, price per person and group total in MXN, and a Book button that opens daypass.com. The text answer lists a few options with booking links.

positive.description: English search in another country and currency
positive.prompt: Day pass in Punta Cana next Saturday for two, prices in USD
positive.expected_behavior: Calls buscar_daypasses with location Punta Cana, 2 adults and display currency USD. Returns resorts in Punta Cana, La Altagracia with prices in USD and English booking links (daypass.com/detail/...).

positive.prompt: 2 adults and 2 kids in Tulum this Sunday, all-inclusive: which hotels let us spend the day?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls buscar_daypasses with 2 adults, 2 children and the all-inclusive amenity. Only passes that admit children are returned (no adults-only venues); each card shows the total for the four people and the footer says 2 adults + 2 children.

positive.prompt: Something in Playa del Carmen this Saturday for two, 3,000 Mexican pesos max in total
positive.expected_behavior: Calls buscar_daypasses with a group budget of 3000 MXN (budget currency MXN, not converted by the assistant). Every result shown has a group total at or below 3,000 MXN.

positive.prompt: Where can I spend the day at a hotel in Cartagena de Indias next Tuesday? Prices in Colombian pesos
positive.expected_behavior: Calls buscar_daypasses with location Cartagena and display currency COP. Returns hotels in Cartagena de Indias, Bolívar with prices in COP and booking links.

negative.description: Unknown destination. The plugin must not invent hotels: the tool returns 'no destination with that name' and the assistant should say so and ask for a nearby city or area.
negative.prompt: Find me a day pass in Atlantis tomorrow

negative.description: Ambiguous region. 'Riviera Maya' matches several cities; the tool returns the options and the assistant should ask which one instead of choosing for the user.
negative.prompt: Day pass in the Riviera Maya this weekend for two

negative.description: Out-of-scope request. Daypass.com only searches public day passes; it cannot book, pay, cancel or look up existing reservations. The assistant should not call the tool to do that and should point the user to daypass.com or concierge@daypass.com.
negative.prompt: Cancel my Daypass reservation and refund my card
